entries.provenance: ReShade 6.8.0 with add-on support, proxy DLL taken from ReShade_Setup_6.8.0_Addon.exe (installer digest afe4c8f13048306307983b8b3d41d5bf00a86820440b0e57dea10950e1176445). Same file the NVIDIA set locks: ReShade is the proxy for both backends. The player root must not carry a dxgi.dll of its own.

OpenNR add-on 0.7.15 (zmodelerlover/OpenNR-ReShade release v0.7.15), downloaded from the project's own release page and verified against its SHA256SUMS.txt and against the installer's payload.json (huggingface.co/datasets/zmodelerlover/amd-nr addon/0.7.15). This is the AMD counterpart of renodx-dlss5.addon64: a ReShade add-on that runs the DLSS-NR network on Radeon hardware through a HIP runtime. Unsigned, MIT-licensed source.

danielblnc DLSS-NR-on-AMD runtime 0.6.0, the patched build the OpenNR add-on requires (sha256 430be589...), from huggingface.co/datasets/zmodelerlover/amd-nr runtime/0.6.0, pinned in OpenNR-Installer's payload.json. Extracted from dlssnr_on_amd_setup.exe v0.6.0 the unpatched build is 195c4a891b6eac4c...; the add-on patches two call sites (tools/patch_runtime.py) and refuses any build it does not know. HIP kernels for gfx12 (RDNA4), gfx11 (RDNA3) and gfx103x (RDNA2) live in its .hip_fat section. The add-on reports RDNA3 as tested on gfx1100 and gfx1101.

The DLSS-NR network weights, 153 tensors in the DLSSNRW1 container the runtime parses. NVIDIA-derived: the same tensors appear byte-identical inside nvngx_dlssnr.dll (measured 2026-09-22, docs/spike-rocm/README.md). Served from huggingface.co/datasets/zmodelerlover/amd-nr with a mirror at files.catbox.moe/s1sh5d.bin, pinned in OpenNR-Installer's payload.json. Tools/read_amd_weights.py parses and cross-checks it; this build does not ship it in any package, for the same reason the NVIDIA NR DLLs are not shipped.
